title: 3 Questions to Ask Yourself When Writing Resume Achievements
description: 3 questions to ask yourself if you don’t feel like there are any metrics associated with your role to include in the bullet point achievements on your resume. Chances are the work you were doing had an impact on SOME part of the business. Even if your metric isn’t exact, that’s ok! Take these questions into consideration when thinking about what to highlight on your resume. #jobsearch #careeradvice #resume #resumeadvice #shorts
